prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate had material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in the 2017 Year of Account. During the year, the exposure to Hurricanes Irma and Maria deteriorated; however, there has been an improvement for Hurricane Harvey.

prior_year_events.event_name: SPA 6118 whole account quota share cession (2015 and prior)
prior_year_events.impact_description: During 2018, in line with the terms of the 2016 YoA QS contract with 1856, the Syndicate ceded 15.4% of its whole account technical reserves, on the 2015 and prior years of account. The accounting treatment, whilst having nil impact on the loss for the year, has caused the Retained combined ratio to increase from 108.0% to 110.6%.

The 2016 year of account has Reinsured to Close (RITC) into the Syndicate's 2017 year of account for an RITC premium of GBP 217.8m. Under Lloyd's Accounting rules, the Syndicate's 2016 year of account closed at the end of 2018, with a return equal to (3.4%) of capacity.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 was GBP 748.9m (Statement of Financial Position). The report does not disclose an explicit gross prior-year development figure; gross claims outstanding increased to GBP 830.4m by 31 December 2018 but that movement includes current year claims, RITC and other items. The underwriting result and reserves were impacted by significant large and catastrophe losses and heavy attritional claims, particularly within Marine, Property and Energy, with material exposure in 2018 to Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, the Camp and Woolsey wildfires and the Lurssen shipyard loss and prior-year exposure to Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria. The Syndicate also ceded 15.4% of whole account technical reserves on 2015 and prior via SPA arrangements and had a 2016 RITC into 2017 (RITC premium GBP 217.8m), which affect comparability of movements.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) 2017 comparative column. The report does not disclose an explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure; movement reconciliation notes and P&L rows contain 'claims incurred in prior accident years' (P&L concept) which per instructions must not be used as PYD. A gross claims development triangle is present but formatting in the extracted text is ambiguous and the triangle contains an aggregated '2012 & prior' column and RITC/SPA cessions that distort comparability; therefore no definitive gross prior-year development amount was calculated. Premium mix taken from the segmental analysis table (regulatory class names copied verbatim). Some mappings and LOB movement directions are inferred from narrative and have moderate confidence.
